summary: Official KZN and national cadastral routes plus an official Edendale cadastral planning map were found. Bounded anonymous inspection did not recover a verified Msunduzi/Edendale parcel API response, safe native parcel identity, schema, CRS, or geometry. Runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and isiZulu first-party discovery queries are recorded in city-5008-edendale.json. English results found the KZN cadastral dashboard, Chief Surveyor-General viewers, and Edendale cadastral PDF; isiZulu results did not expose a separate public parcel service.
requestOutcomes: The KZN dashboard HTML opened but its anonymous ArcGIS REST item/data requests returned 403. The eThekwini Parcels service was identified from first-party ArcGIS metadata but direct map/query requests failed local TLS verification; no TLS exception was used. The CSG viewer host was not resolvable. The official Edendale PDF was fetched/reviewed as static map evidence.
scopeLimits: The official KZN cadastral dashboard and Edendale cadastral PDF establish map/custodian evidence, not an open parcel adapter.
The eThekwini cadastral service is a different municipal service and its advertised extent does not cover the exact Edendale point; no coverage inference was made.
No exact-point hit or miss, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI was treated as evidence of citywide absence, and the WUP point was not shifted.
The static PDF labels were not converted into synthetic identities or digitized into retained geometry.
No GeoJSON sample was retained because no safe native parcel geometry and identity response was obtained.
This packet is research evidence only and must not be treated as source integration or adapter admission.
nativeIdentityPolicy: No machine-readable native parcel identity was obtained; do not synthesize one from PDF labels, response order, dashboard rows, or internal records.
crs: unverified; no parcel geometry response obtained
geometryQuality: not evaluated; no parcel geometry retained
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review and adapter qualification still required
uncertainty: A restricted, separately configured, or browser-only KZN/CSG cadastral service may exist. Public Msunduzi coverage, parcel schema, CRS, native identity, and safe anonymous runtime access remain unresolved.
